cues: Horizontal planks mounted at intervals create open tiers where rows of novels can stand upright.
Some designs include adjustable supports, letting readers accommodate volumes of different heights.
An upright frame often places several uncovered ledges against a study wall.
Heavy encyclopedias are commonly arranged spine-out across its sturdy wooden levels.
Many versions have a broad top and vertical sides supporting multiple open shelves.
Small brackets or pins can hold each removable board at a chosen height.
